blocks.text: For a while there, the government had reason to rejoice. On Oct. 6, the Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 228 convicted two men—accused mastermind Dante Encarnacion Tabusares and gunman Junell Jane Andagkit Poten—of murder for the killing of Kidapawan radio journalist Eduardo “Ed” Dizon on July 10, 2019.
